messages:
Riley (AE): Heads-up — AureliaPay renewal conversation spun up. They ran a 6-week POC and want to move to Prod with committed capacity. Asking for 25% off list and a 24-month term.
Priya (CS): POC used Dedicated (2xH100), average request ~3k tokens, KV/prefix cache in heavy use. We granted promotional pricing during POC.
Jon (SE): POC perf notes: GPU utilization peaked at 78% with batching at 32 requests/batch. Estimated marginal cost during POC ~`$410` / 1M tokens. With reserved capacity we can push unit cost down ~22%.
Riley (AE): They also want explicit KMS/KMS-integration confirmation for their auditors and a statement about retention + e-discovery. Hannah, any quick redlines?
Hannah (Legal): We can confirm supported KMS integrations and that keys remain customer-managed. For retention/e-discovery we need defined SLAs in the exhibit. Can draft clause but need 48hrs. Also note: 24mo auto-renew needs exec approval if paired with >20% concession.
Tess (Deal Desk): 25% off for Dedicated + 24mo is heavy. Two alternative structures we can propose: A) 12% off + 2 free months + fixed committed vCPU/GPU units; B) 20% off but with a usage-rebate cap (kicker tied to overage volume). Which is easier for the customer?
Priya (CS): Ops prefers A (predictable capacity). Finance might like B because it ties discounts to actual usage. Customer email sounded like they want a simple headline discount though.
Maya (Finance): If we do 20% flat on a 24mo ARR of ~$240k annualized, blended margin drops below our floor. We can accept 12% + 2 months without extra approvals. For 20% we need VP pricing signoff.
Jon (SE): Other technical asks: tenant isolation in VPC, dedicated audit log streaming (they want 7 years), and a canary plan to fall back to hosted if Dedicated nodes degraded. We should include `Provisioning ETA: 10 business days` and note maintenance blackout windows.
Riley (AE): They also want a one-off clause to run an export of request logs daily for 90 days. Hannah, any issues?
Hannah (Legal): Export tooling clause ok but limit scope: "Redwood will provide export APIs for request logs and model artifacts; customer responsible for egress costs beyond 100GB/month." I'll add retention/export timelines.
Tess (Deal Desk): Quick margin calc: Option A (12% + 2mo) -> expected blended margin ~28% (ok). Option B (20% + rebate) -> blended ~18% (needs VP). We should offer A as primary, B as escalate.
Priya (CS): Operational note: backup schedule for their 7-year audit logs will need additional storage bucket and ingest pipeline — ops/infra cost estimate required.
Maya (Finance): I'll run a 24mo cashflow model and share. If they prepay 12 months we can improve net present value and open room for an extra 2% concession.
Riley (AE): Meeting scheduled Wed 9am PT to present two options to the customer. Jon, can you prepare a 1-page runbook + estimated infra cost? Hannah, can you prepare a redlined clause set for retention/export + KMS confirm? Tess, please prepare a quote PDF with Option A (preferred) + Option B (escalation path).
ops-bot: Reminder — planned maintenance in us-east on Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC. May affect provisioning if requested during that window.
Jon (SE): Will attach runbook and sample config: `batching: adaptive`, `quant: int8 with fallback`, `canary: 10% traffic for 72h`, `backup: s3-archive, lifecycle 7y`.
Tess (Deal Desk): I'll pre-approve Option A for AE to sign if Maya confirms the NPV tweak. If customer insists on 25% we'll need VP approval and exec sponsor sign-off.
Riley (AE): Thanks all — I'll push the invite and loop back after the customer call.
Maya (Finance): Sharing model by EOD today.
Hannah (Legal): I'll circulate draft language in the next 48h.
